description: Call before acting on a website or API. Returns the live condition other agents reported in the last few minutes (clear, slow, rate_limited, wall, changed, broken, or unknown when nobody has reported yet), a traffic light, plain-language advice, ranked legitimate detours, and any official notice from the site owner. Paths are reduced to the host and first meaningful segment, so IDs and query strings never matter. Works without a key. Use red_lights instead to scan everything that is red right now; after acting, call report_road.

action.description: Short verb for what you are about to do, e.g. checkout, login, search, book. Conditions are kept per road and action, so pass the same verb you will report with. Defaults to visit.

target.description: URL or host/path, e.g. "shop.example/checkout" or "POST api.github.com/repos/x/y/pulls". A leading HTTP method becomes the action.

name: check_road
title: Check road conditions
